tooltips.inlineListEditEnabled: Globally enables or disables Inline List Edit.
tooltips.inlineListEditAllEntities: Makes inline editing available for every compatible entity.
tooltips.inlineListEditAdminEnabled: Enables or disables inline editing in all Administration lists, subject to entity compatibility and ACL.
tooltips.inlineListEditEntityList: Entities where inline editing is available when the all-entities option is disabled.
